description: This file contains implementation of serialization and deserialization functions for ewah_bitmap data structures, including functions to serialize to memory, write to strbuf, and read from memory map. It interacts with external utilities and other modules related to ewah bitmaps.

methods.name: int ewah_serialize_to(struct ewah_bitmap * self,int (* write_fun)(void *,const void *,size_t),void * data)
methods.description: Serializes an ewah_bitmap structure into an output stream using a user-provided write function, including bitmap size, buffer, and rlw position.

methods.name: int ewah_serialize_strbuf(struct ewah_bitmap * self,struct strbuf * sb)
methods.description: Serializes an ewah_bitmap into a strbuf object.

methods.name: ssize_t ewah_read_mmap(struct ewah_bitmap * self,const void * map,size_t len)
methods.description: Reads and reconstructs an ewah_bitmap from a memory-mapped input buffer, performing endian conversions and data copying.

methods.name: int write_strbuf(void * user_data,const void * data,size_t len)

ctags.name: ewah_read_mmap
ctags.pattern: /^ssize_t ewah_read_mmap(struct ewah_bitmap *self, const void *map, size_t len)$/

ctags.name: write_strbuf
ctags.pattern: /^static int write_strbuf(void *user_data, const void *data, size_t len)$/
